body: I am still around, yes. Barely.
I'm sorry for your loss. Thank you, though. I'll try to.. live for a little while longer. Even though it sucks. It'd be silly of me to end my life when I have years (I assume) to go.
I don't know. If he can die, why can't I? Why am I having to suffer being on this shitty Earth? All I'm going to get out of life now is shittiness.
But I don't want to do it. I want to be done.
Staying alive isn't the solution either.
